violations.why: The ISR can preempt the task between the two writes and read an intermediate value (0x01) that the final write overwrites. Interrupts are never masked.
The ISR can run between the writes at lines 27 and 29 and observe 0x09, which is immediately overwritten by 0x05.
If v_meadow==1, the ISR can read between the write at line 21 and the write at line 27, seeing the transient value 0x01.
